name: Release v1.0 with Ollama Support

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'package.json'
      - 'lib/**'
      - 'src/**'
      - '.github/workflows/release.yml'

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build Package
        run: npm run build

      - name: Validate Ollama Provider Integration
        run: |
          # Check if Ollama provider files exist
          if [ -f "lib/providers/ollama.ts" ] && [ -f "lib/utils/registry.ts" ]; then
            echo "Ollama provider files found"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Ollama provider files missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify Ollama is registered in provider registry
          if grep -q "ollama" lib/utils/registry.ts; then
            echo "Ollama provider registered successfully"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Ollama not registered in provider registry"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Semantic Release
        id: semantic_release
        uses: cycjimmy/semantic-release-action@v4
        with:
          branch: main
          extra_plugins: |
            @semantic-release/github
            @semantic-release/npm
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: steps.semantic_release.outputs.new_release_published == 'true'
        run: |
          npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update Documentation
        if: steps.semantic_release.outputs.new_release_published == 'true'
        run: |
          # Update README with Ollama usage instructions
          echo "# Ollama Support" >> README.md
          echo "Morphic now supports Ollama for self-hosted AI deployments." >> README.md
          echo "" >> README.md
          echo "## Environment Variables" >> README.md
          echo "- \`OLLAMA_BASE_URL\` - URL of your Ollama instance" >> README.md
          echo "- \`OLLAMA_MODEL\` - Model name to use" >> README.md
          echo "" >> README.md
          echo "## Usage" >> README.md
          echo "```ts" >> README.md
          echo "import { createMorphic } from 'morphic';" >> README.md
          echo "" >> README.md
          echo "const morphic = createMorphic({ provider: 'ollama' });" >> README.md
          echo "```" >> README.md
          git add README.md
          git commit -m "docs: update documentation for Ollama support" || true

      - name: Push Documentation Changes
        if: steps.semantic_release.outputs.new_release_published == 'true'
        run: |
          git push origin main
```
